sourcePolicy: Project-original operator archetypes authored for Atomic Acres. Broad archetype spirit only (adventurous explorer, bulky symbiote-like composite, naval special operations); no franchise likeness, trademarked names, copied characters, extracted assets, or licensed geometry.

canonicalRigContract.CRITICAL: The canonical rig has exactly 62 joints, 24 animation clips, and four material names Skin/Swat/Swat_Black/Visor that runtime team tinting depends on. Every archetype MUST keep those four material names unrenamed and MUST NOT alter the skeleton (no joint added, removed, renamed, or re-parented) and MUST NOT alter the clip set.
canonicalRigContract.materialNamePolicy: Immutable: archetypes restyle the four canonical materials in place; team-tint lookup binds to these exact names.
canonicalRigContract.skeletonPolicy: Immutable: all 62 canonical joints and all 24 canonical animation clips must remain present and valid on every archetype.
canonicalRigContract.accessorySkinningPolicy: Accessories may only be skinned/parented to EXISTING joint names listed in this contract's joint inventory; no new bones, sockets, or drivers.
canonicalRigContract.silhouetteProfilePolicy: HF-380: recolours and bolt-on props alone left every archetype reading as the same base male mesh. Each archetype therefore carries a non-radial, region-weighted reshaping of the REST-POSE vertices only (vertex-group-masked; skeleton, bone names, skin weights and clips stay byte-identical to the canonical operator). Params are bounded by silhouetteProfileBounds and every archetype must satisfy its own distinctnessGates measured against the pristine canonical bind pose, fail-closed at authoring time.

hitProxyEnvelope.semantics: Composed visual silhouette (mesh bounds after proportion and accessory scaling) must stay within maxSilhouetteScale times the authoritative hit-proxy capsule. A body larger than its hitbox makes shots visibly pass through, so the per-archetype maxSilhouetteScale field is a hard fail-closed bound.

operators.designIntent: Lean, weathered long-range trekker whose sun-faded canvas kit and raised goggles read instantly as trail-worn adventure without echoing any franchise character.

silhouetteProfile.intent: Lean, shorter trail runner: visibly narrower frame, pinched waist, slim limbs, athletic taper. Params match the measured HF-380 proof receipt.

operators.designIntent: Imposing bulk built from layered bio-composite graft plates grown over a heavy frame, deliberately capped by the hit-proxy silhouette envelope so mass never outruns shot authority.

silhouetteProfile.intent: Imposing heavy frame: broader shoulders, thicker arms and legs, taller stance. Bulk stays under the 1.1 hit-proxy envelope cap.

operators.silhouetteBoundNote: Hard cap: even with bulk multipliers applied, the composed silhouette must stay within 1.1x the authoritative hit-proxy capsule; authoring stages must clamp rather than exceed it.

operators.designIntent: Compact maritime special-operations raider in low-cut neoprene-style layering with muted blue-grey tones tuned for waterline insertion silhouettes.

silhouetteProfile.intent: Compact, low-profile waterline raider: slightly shorter and narrower, slim limbs, minimal radial bulk. legRadiusTarget was authored at 0.80 and measured out at thighMeanRadius 0.9247 against this archetype's own 0.90 distinctness gate: the slim factor is applied per vertex weight, so the delivered radius change is about a third of the authored target. Retargeted to 0.66, which measures inside the gate while staying well within contract bounds and squarely on this archetype's slim-limb intent. The gate itself is unchanged.
